nodes.name: Watch ERA Folder
nodes.notes: Polls GCW ERA Google Drive folder every 5 min. Replace folderToWatch value with the era_folder_id from practice_settings. Uses same Google OAuth credential as EOB watcher.

nodes.name: Download ERA File
nodes.notes: Downloads the ERA file binary. Output: $binary.data (base64). File name available at $json.name from trigger.

nodes.name: Parse ERA CSV → Line Items
nodes.notes: Parses Trizetto ERA CSV export into EraLineItem[] for ingest-era-data. Handles 835 EDI gracefully (skip + warn — ask biller for CSV export). Column resolver handles common header name variations.

nodes.name: POST to ingest-era-data
nodes.notes: Calls Supabase edge function (deployed --no-verify-jwt). Set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in n8n Environment Variables. Returns: { success, records_processed, records_inserted, bq_errors }.

nodes.name: Log Success
nodes.notes: Clean success: BQ rows inserted, pipeline_events logged in Supabase.

nodes.name: Send Error Alert

parameters.subject: =⚠️ GCW ERA sync error — {{ $now.toISO() }}
parameters.message:
=GCW ERA Google Drive sync encountered an error.

Response: {{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}
